# Team Plan Pricing Inputs

Decision: evaluate increasing the Team plan from USD 20 to USD 24 per account per month.

- 2,000 paying Team accounts.
- Current monthly logo churn: 2%.
- Gross margin: 80%.
- Interview evidence: 7 of 12 buyers value shared approvals; evidence is directional, not willingness-to-pay proof.
- No packaging test or price sensitivity study exists.

The decision is reversible through a new-customer test. Do not make a portfolio allocation decision or claim validated willingness to pay.
